top_signals.title: A Slew of Earnings | Closing Bell
top_signals.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Emily Graffeo, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: UPS CEO on Return to Growth, Global Economic Outlook
top_signals.summary: UPS CEO Carol Tomé sees a positive future for the company ahead in large part to the restructuring of priorities away from Amazon delivery, and upgrades to their digital platforms and infrastructure. She speaks to Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's 'The Close.' (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Senate approves Trump's pick for spy chief, ending Bill Pulte's brief tenure
top_signals.summary: The Senate on Tuesday approved Jay Clayton, President Donald Trump's nominee to become the director of national intelligence.

top_signals.title: Jim Cramer: How to avoid getting burned by parabolic stocks
top_signals.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer urged investors to take profits as stocks go parabolic, saying those explosive rallies often unravel just as quickly once momentum fades.

top_signals.title: Lloyd’s of London allows staff to work from home as heatwave hits the capital
top_signals.summary: Lloyd’s of London is allowing its staff to stay away from the historic City building as yet another heatwave threatens to hit London.  The home of the world’s leading specialist insurance and reinsurance marketplace has told staff they are able to use their judgement and work from home this week with temperatures in the Square [...]
